description: This Java class 'ExecHelper' manages execution and output handling of an external simulator process, primarily used for auto-testing. It includes methods to start, dump output, and destroy the simulator process, with logging and threading for output streams.

classes.name: ExecHelper
classes.description: Helper class for executing and managing an external simulator process, including starting, output dumping, and destruction.

methods.name: runSimulator
methods.description: Starts the simulator process, logs its size, output, and exit value.

methods.name: dumpProcessOutput
methods.description: Reads and logs the output and error streams of a process.

methods.name: readAndPrint
methods.description: Reads lines from a BufferedReader and passes them to a consumer.

methods.name: createErrorStreamEcho
methods.description: Creates a Runnable that reads and logs the error stream of a process.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the simulator process if it exists.

methods.name: startSimulator
methods.description: Starts the simulator process in a new thread.
